integrity_note: The exact stated theorem has an analytical proof and a reproducible special-case checker; scientific conclusions and priority have not received independent audit.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes a tempered stationary-increment Gaussian parent with Hurst exponent strictly greater than one half.
The gamma Lévy clock is independent and the gamma diffusivity is fixed per trajectory; neither time-varying diffusivity nor independently reselected window diffusivities are covered.
The expansion is uniform in observation separation at fixed physical parameters, not uniformly at parameter singularities.
The far-gap floor is a consequence of the established one-window kurtosis; priority is asserted only for the joint finite-gap and two-scale statements.
Finite reproducibility checks do not establish universal claims or independent certification.
title: Two-scale volatility correlations in tempered fractional Laplace motion
